title: Common Type Definitions
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Shared type definitions used across multiple schemas. Referenced via cross-schema $ref.

vec3.description: 3-component vector (x, y, z) in metres. Each component uses value+unit format per ADR-0008.

quat.description: Unit quaternion (x, y, z, w) for rotation. Defaults to identity (no rotation).

x.description: X component of the quaternion imaginary part. Default 0.0.

y.description: Y component of the quaternion imaginary part. Default 0.0.

z.description: Z component of the quaternion imaginary part. Default 0.0.

w.description: W component (real/scalar part) of the quaternion. Default 1.0 (identity).

orbital_parameters.description: Orbital movement parameters for celestial bodies and belt/field entities. All values in SI units (metres, seconds, radians) after conversion. These are world-specific, not template-specific. For belt/field entities, rotation_period and axial_tilt are not used. orbital_parent, orbital_distance, and orbital_period are only required when the entity orbits a parent body.

orbital_parent.description: ID of the parent body this entity orbits. If absent, the entity does not orbit (e.g., sun, free-floating body).

orbital_period.description: Orbital period in seconds. Required for celestial bodies, not used for belt/field entities.

orbital_eccentricity.description: Orbital eccentricity (0 = circular, 0.1-0.9 = increasingly elliptical). Default: 0 (circular).

orbital_inclination.description: Orbital inclination in degrees (angle above/below the ecliptic plane). Default: 0 (in ecliptic).

initial_orbital_angle.description: Starting angle in the orbital plane at time zero, in degrees. Default: 0.

rotation_period.description: Rotation period in hours. None means no rotation.

axial_tilt.description: Axial tilt (obliquity) in degrees. Angle between rotation axis and orbital axis. Default: 0 (no tilt).

asteroid_belt_parameters.description: Additional parameters specific to asteroid belt entities. Extends orbital_parameters with belt-specific fields.

radial_extent.description: Radial extent of a belt in metres (how far the ring reaches inward and outward from the orbital distance).

thickness.description: Thickness of a belt in metres (how far it reaches above and below the orbital plane).

mean_spacing.description: Mean spacing between asteroids in metres (density of the fill).

excluded_radii.description: Radii where nothing is placed (e.g., Kirkwood gaps). Array of objects with orbital_distance and gap_radius.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic procedural generation. Required for belt/field entities.

sector_size.description: Cache granularity for belt sectors in metres (engine detail, not content).

size_distribution.description: Which asteroid sizes are placed and how often. Array of objects with radius and weight.

density.description: Material density in kg/m³ for generated asteroids (used to compute mass from radius).

asteroid_field_parameters.description: Additional parameters specific to asteroid field entities. Extends orbital_parameters with field-specific fields.

extent.description: Extent of a field region in metres (how large the region is).

mean_spacing.description: Mean spacing between asteroids in metres (density of the fill).

seed.description: Seed for deterministic procedural generation. Required for belt/field entities.

sector_size.description: Cache granularity for field sectors in metres (engine detail, not content).

size_distribution.description: Which asteroid sizes are placed and how often. Array of objects with radius and weight.

density.description: Material density in kg/m³ for generated asteroids (used to compute mass from radius).
